stories.title: Threat was to US base not town, says MP
stories.summary: A Suffolk MP says the government tells him the threat was not imminent.

stories.title: DJ Tim Westwood denies two more sexual offences
stories.summary: His latest pleas of not guilty mean he now denies a total of 17 charges concerning allegations from 1983 to 2016.

stories.title: Disruption as lorry fire shuts part of A14
stories.summary: Motorists report thick black smoke pouring into the sky.

stories.title: US military base vital to home security, says MP
stories.summary: James Cartlidge says the US presence in Suffolk helps bolster safety, as planes are moved out.

stories.title: Cuts to child health services after council vote
stories.summary: The Labour MP for Ipswich says the decision brings "another dark day for children and families".

stories.title: Pride as war memorials are granted listed status
stories.summary: The monuments at Barrack Square, Martlesham Heath, are being given Grade II listed status.

stories.title: Nurse threatened to kill colleague, report finds
stories.summary: Rupesh Patel said he would "hunt down" and "kill" his whole family, a panel says.

stories.title: Contract agreed for asylum camp at former RAF base
stories.summary: The Home Office awards a £3.4m deal to design the controversial site, ahead of any final decision.

stories.title: Man dies in four-vehicle crash in suburban street
stories.summary: Police are trying to find out if the driver who died had a medical incident before the crash.

stories.title: Women Rise Together's business awards triumph
stories.summary: A ceremony in Ipswich recognises the achievements of black and minority ethnic entrepreneurs.

stories.title: Watch: Erosion threatens home of Darkness singer's parents
stories.summary: Justin Hawkins says his parents have lived in the property on the Suffolk coast for about 20 years.

stories.title: Sixth form to remain open while options explored
stories.summary: The sixth form paused Year 12 admissions in September.
